name: Fear Me
source:
A small adventure of horror, mystery, hope and quirkiness.

Will you be able to keep your sanity intact?

Make your choices and be careful not to split.

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/fearme]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段融合恐怖、谜团、希望与古怪元素的小小冒险。

你能保持理智吗？

作出选择，并小心别让自己分崩离析。

[来源：[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/fearme]Itch.io[/url]]
